name: core-vote-cap
description: Rules audit (core, switch TI4_VOTE_CHECK, on by default): LRR 8 - votes come from exhausted planets' influence plus the voter's vote sources and vote action cards. The original's 'Modify Votes' accepted any number; now a confirmed count above what the voter had when they pressed Vote (AgendaHelper's vote total + 5 per Distinguished Councilor + trade goods with Bribery in hand) is refused (VoteRules: bot resolveAgendaVote_, agenda.vote_step validate). Base: pbd72@768 (winnu about to confirm a vote): winnu presses Vote, then confirming 40 votes is refused; 1 vote goes through.
